_comment: Manual opponent-swap corrections for bouts where the Cito API has a stale/wrong fighter in a corner (e.g. an injury replacement the API hasn't picked up yet). The update-odds workflow re-fetches data/event.json from scratch every run and would otherwise silently wipe these fixes — apply-fighter-overrides.js re-applies every entry here on top of the fresh fetch before it's committed. Remove an entry once the upstream API fixes itself (or once the event has passed).

overrides.reason: Andreas Gustafsson withdrew from his bout with Daniil Donchenko due to a cardiac issue (atrial fibrillation) discovered in training camp; Theodor Berggren stepped in as a short-notice replacement (UFC debut). Confirmed via UFC.com fight preview, Tapology, and LowKickMMA reporting (May 2026). Cito API still lists Gustafsson as of this writing.

Ode' Osbourne withdrew (injury); Alessandro Costa steps in on ~2 weeks' notice to face Cody Durden at UFC 329. Confirmed via Sherdog, Heavy, and BoxingNews (July 2026). Cito API still listed Osbourne as of 2026-07-03. Costa took the fight on short notice.
Ethyn Ewing withdrew from his bout with Farid Basharat (injury; flagged in the news feed); John Garza steps in as a short-notice replacement at UFC 329. Cito API still lists Ewing as of this writing.

Veronica Hardy pulled out of her UFC Oklahoma City bout with Dione Barbosa; Anna Melisano (Bisping's No. 1 TUF 34 pick) stepped in on short notice. The ESPN feed already lists Melisano, so this entry only marks her as the short-notice replacement. Confirmed via MMA Fighting and Sherdog (July 2026).

Allen Frye Jr. fell off the UFC Oklahoma City card; RJ Harris stepped in on short notice to face Alvin Hines. The ESPN feed already lists Harris, so this entry only marks him as the short-notice replacement.

Khalil Rountree Jr. withdrew from the UFC Fight Night main event vs. Magomed Ankalaev; Bogdan Guskov stepped in on short notice — Wikipedia already retitled the card 'Ankalaev vs. Guskov'. The ESPN feed still lists Rountree as of this writing, so swap the blue corner to Guskov and mark him the short-notice replacement (which also suppresses the mis-fired 'Rountree stepped in on short notice' / bout-may-change flags).

Not a short-notice swap — an upstream ESPN data error. ESPN's feed has the Aug 8 heavyweight bout vs. Louie Sutherland attributed to Henrique da Silva Lopes (5-2-0, a different, already-UFC-rostered Brazilian heavyweight — Jungle Fight/WOC background), whose profile also carries the nickname "Montanha" in ESPN's data. The actual opponent is Jose Montanha (Jose Luiz "Montanha", 6-1-0, Curitiba, Parana) — confirmed via Sherdog's fighter page (which lists this exact bout under his 'Upcoming Fights'), Tapology, and MMA news coverage of his original Diniz booking collapsing and Sutherland stepping in. The two fighters just happen to share the nickname 'Montanha', and ESPN's feed appears to have merged them.

Danny Silva withdrew from his featherweight bout with Marcio Barbosa at UFC Sacramento (hospitalized by a sudden pulmonary embolism); Ryan Kuse steps in on short notice for his promotional debut. The ESPN feed already lists Kuse, and card-changes.json's Wikipedia-diff heuristic flagged this bout as 'mayChange' (naming Kuse, the fighter who stayed booked, rather than the fighter who withdrew) — this entry marks Kuse as the confirmed short-notice replacement, which takes priority over that mis-fired 'may change' flag. Confirmed via UFC.com's fight-by-fight Sacramento preview and Fightomic (Aug 2026).

Kody Steele withdrew (injury) from his lightweight bout with Gauge Young at UFC Sacramento; Stan Dorsainvil signed with the UFC and steps in on short notice (six days before an LFA date he'd already signed for) for his UFC debut. The ESPN feed already lists Dorsainvil, and card-changes.json's Wikipedia-diff heuristic flagged this bout as 'mayChange' (naming Young, the fighter who stayed booked, rather than the fighter who withdrew) — this entry marks Dorsainvil as the confirmed short-notice replacement, which takes priority over that mis-fired 'may change' flag. Confirmed via AgentMMA and the Sedalia Democrat (Aug 2026).
